Subject: Atlas Payables — merchant identity + PO routing integration

Hi Evan —

Thanks for onboarding with Redwood. I’m Sofia on the vendor onboarding team; Laura (procurement) and Marcus (finance) are looped for the vendor setup and payment routing. To get Atlas Payables fully active in our systems and ensure PO-driven payments work smoothly, we need a few items from you. Can you return these by end of week (Fri, Sep 3) if possible?

Required items:
1) Legal entity name exactly as registered (for vendor record and 1099/EIN mapping)
2) Tax ID / EIN and entity type (LLC, Corp, Sole Prop) + a completed W-9 or W-8 if applicable
3) Remit-to address and remittance email (for emailed remittance advices)
4) ACH details (bank name, account type, last 4 digits, routing number) — if you prefer wire, include wire instructions
5) Preferred payment terms (Net30/Net45) and PO acceptance expectations (do you require PO number to match invoice for payment?)
6) AP contact name, phone and email for payment coordination
7) Any reseller/contractor sub-entities we should capture (if payments go to a different legal entity)

Optional but helpful:
- Sample invoice with PO number shown (PDF)
- Any EDI/ERPi specs or field mapping notes for PO -> invoice matching

Attachments: I’ll attach our supplier onboarding form (fillable) in a follow-up. Once we receive the items above we’ll: create your vendor code, set default GL routing, configure PO rules (require PO yes/no), and schedule a test ACH for a small amount to validate routing.

If you’d prefer a quick 20-minute call to walk through this, I’m available Tuesday/Wednesday afternoons PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments — received W-9 and ACH file. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/finance: 

• We will set up Atlas Payables as vendor code AP-1924 in our ERP. Expect that to be completed by end of day Thu (Sep 2).
• Redwood standard payment terms are Net30. Given your default is Net45, we can set Net30 for your vendor record as an exception if you confirm in writing that PO numbers will always be present on invoices and you’ll accept the test ACH procedure.
• For PO routing: our AP system will block payment for invoices that do not include a valid PO number. Please ensure the PO field is populated on all invoices.
• Tax withholding: if Atlas has any foreign sub-entities or non-US tax status, we’ll need the appropriate W-8. Otherwise W-9 is sufficient.

Action items for Atlas (confirm):
- Confirm you accept Net30 for Redwood (we’ll apply exception)
- Confirm remittance email (payables@atlaspay.com) is correct for EDI/AS2 notifications
- Confirm you want ACH test ($0.10 or $1.00) to validate routing — we prefer $0.10 micro-deposit then a confirmation email from your AP to unlock live payments

I’ve attached our standard Supplier_Onboarding_Form.docx (fillable) — please return with the contact details populated so we can finalize vendor setup.

Marcus — once Evan confirms, please proceed with vendor creation and set payment term to Net30 exception and PO-required flag on the vendor record. Also please add default GL code 5002 (SaaS Subscriptions) unless Evan requests otherwise.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
